evidence: The initial growth of Co thin films during plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PE-ALD) is investigated by atomic force microscopy (AFM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and synchrotron radiation X-ray reflectivity (SR-XRR). ... AFM and SEM were used with XRR as complementary analysis tools to investigate the initial-growth stage of Co thin films. ... XRR measurements were conducted at the 3C2 XRD beamline of the Pohang Light Source.
